standard: K-20 (Katz / SMPTE RP 200); loudness ITU-R BS.1770 (LUFS), ceiling dBTP

rule.pitched: the integrated figure — K-weighted RMS over the whole sounding note
rule.percussion: the loudest 400 ms, K-weighted — 0d’s rule, because a one-shot’s integrated value follows its ring length
rule.remainder: a JS: Volume Adjustment FX, as 0d did (§58)
